results.title: UK first in Europe to approve Eli Lilly oral weight loss drug
results.description: Britain has become the first country in Europe to approve orforglipron, the oral weight loss and diabetes treatment developed by US company Eli Lilly, the UK government has revealed. Eli Lilly's Mounjaro weight loss drug, like Wegovy, is injected. bcp/ajb/st

results.title: Centre supports states in implementing menstrual hygiene policy for school-going girls
results.description: New Delhi, August 11, 2026 (Yes Punjab News) The Centre is supporting states and Union Territories (UTs) in implementing the Menstrual Hygiene Policy for school-going girls through coordinated action aimed at ensuring access to safe and affordable menstrual hygiene measures in schools, the Rajya Sabha was informed on Tuesday.
